description: Rename a build (flow) authoritatively across the platform in one call: the builder header, list_flows / open_in_builder, and the Deerlake catalog all reflect the new title, and updatedAt is bumped. A deployed build keeps its hosted web app: the hostname and version history are unchanged, and the next deploy_flow publishes the next version. Does NOT edit the app source: rename a hardcoded old name yourself with write_flow_files.
name: flow_rename_flow
title: Rename a flow
